EmailTemplate.name: GRAD Application Deadlines
EmailTemplate.subject: Application deadline info for Arizona State University
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Graduate Admission Services. All application deadlines are set and enforced by the specific academic program you are applying to, so we recommend that you contact the program directly to find out when they need to have all application materials and documents received by our office. You can find contact information for the program at the bottom of the program description page in our online academic catalog at https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/graduate/false.
Thank you,
Graduate Admission Services
If you have any additional questions related to this, please reply to this email.
